svg.title: The pictures of a visual change
svg.desc: Dennis or a bot pushes to a pull request that changes how something looks, and its visual check renders the pictures again and keeps each one that looks different in an artifact, before and after. When the check passed, the pager asks GitHub for the pull request, with a token of its app. One of someone else, from a fork, or that moved on to a newer head ends there, and so does a head whose pictures went already. Otherwise the pager reads the artifact with the same token, through the short-lived address of its storage. When every picture looks as committed, nothing comes. When some look different, their message goes into the topic of its release, or of a thing of their own, and the album of the largest changes follows, before and after, at most three pictures. The merge or the end of the pull request ticks the topic off.
